title: Claudius II Gothicus - Antoninianus - Roman Coin VICTORIA AVG - IMP CLAVDIVS AVG
description:
Roman Imperial Coin – Antoninianus of Claudius II Gothicus
 

 Roman Empire, AD 268–270


 Issuer: Roman Empire
 

 Emperor: Claudius II Gothicus (Marcus Aurelius Claudius)
 

 Reign: AD 268–270
 

 Denomination: Antoninianus
 

 Currency reform: Antoninianus of Caracalla (AD 215–301)
 

 Mint: Rome
 

 Date: AD 268–270 (undated)


 Composition: Silver (billon)
 

 Weight: 3.06g
 

 Diameter: 20.8mm
 

 Shape: Irregular round
 

 Manufacture: Hammered
 

 Status: Demonetized


 Obverse:
 

 Radiate bust of Claudius II Gothicus, draped or cuirassed, facing right.
 

 Legend: IMP CLAVDIVS AVG
 

 Translation: Imperator Claudius Augustus


 Reverse:
 

 Victory standing left, winged and draped, holding wreath in right hand and palm branch in left; officina mark in left field.
 

 Legend: VICTORIA AVG
 

 Translation: Victory of the Emperor


 References:
 

 RIC V.1, no. 105
 

 OCRE: ric.5.cg.105
 

 Numista catalogue no. 290193


 Historical note:
 

 Claudius II Gothicus ruled during a turbulent period of the Roman Empire and is best known for his victory over the Goths, commemorated by the Victory reverse type.
